lines: Elva: Every map we print has one blank street.
Elva: Lampblack Lane. Same plate, same ink. Always white.
Elva: The press is fine. I took it apart twice.
Elva: Old Pennick set that lane by hand. He's in Rimeholt.

elva_after: Elva: Pennick's in Rimeholt. Bring him a scarf.

lines: Linnet: This is it. Lampblack Lane. Dab? It's all right.
A small Nibbet peers out of a gutter. Its mouth is all ink.
Its call is thin and smeared, like the Blot all over town.
Rift-born ones need an anchor bond. One person. Not a door.
Linnet: Then I'll be its person. Dab? Will you have me?
Dab licks Linnet's thumb instead of the street.
Behind them, the lane's cobbles turn dark with fresh ink.

lane_after: Linnet: Dab doesn't eat streets now. Only my lunch.

lines: Linnet: Dab won't come out. The ledgers are too loud.
Linnet: You've come to seal Dab out. Like a Rift.
Linnet: Dab hides in the lane. It has no one but me.
Linnet: Mavet would bottle it. The Guild would bill it.
Linnet: Beat me first. Then maybe I'll listen.

linnet_after: Linnet: Lampblack Lane. Come when the town is quiet.
linnet_defeat: Linnet: Fine. You fight like you mean well.
Linnet: Pennick says Dab needs a person, not a door.
linnet_lose: Linnet: Dab stays hidden. Go away.

lines: Linnet: Go away. I'm busy. Not hiding anything.
Pennick: Lampblack Lane? I set it fifty years back.
Pennick: The ink isn't fading. Something licks it off.
Pennick: A small Nibbet. No home side. Came through a Rift.
Pennick: It eats the lane so the thin place stays open.
Pennick: It wants to go back. It can't. It just smudges.
Pennick: Here we call that the Blot. It spreads from there.
Pennick: Young Linnet feeds it. Ledgerholm. Go gently.

pennick_after: Pennick: Linnet's in Ledgerholm. She bites. Nicely.

lines: Pennick: Too cold to talk. The bath fumes get in my bones.
Elva: First full print in years. Lampblack Lane. Black.
Linnet brought Dab. It sits on the plate, good as gold.
Pennick: Fifty years. My lane's on the map again.
Under the press the Blot goes quiet. Nothing smudges.
Elva: Take this copy. Your name's in the corner, {name}.

print_after: Elva: Lampblack Lane, every print. I check every one.

lines: Elva: Not until the great press is mended. Then we print.
